protocol: Real reference record: Fermi GBM photon energy channels (REAL)
status: frozen before the first formal run (confirmation day); specified after CAL-1..CAL-4 and not part of them
amendment_2026-10-31: Same correction of the calibration step as in calibration_unknown_center.json (bound on |d| now from the first split). No parameter changed; the confirmation-day run was repeated on the same files, and the earlier output is in the version history of the repository. Crossing counts were unchanged on both days; development_result below is the pre-amendment record, and the repeated development run gives a median gain of 31.1% at shift 0.12.
note_days: The development day was inspected during exploration and used to debug and tune the design (results/real_gbm_dev.json). The confirmation day was not downloaded or opened before this file was frozen; only its directory listing was checked for file availability.
note_characterization: Events of the first hour fix the unit (their mean and standard deviation) and the envelope K8 = factor x their standardized eighth central moment; windows start after the last characterization event.
note_exclusion: A candidate window is dropped when its reference holds fewer than rate_floor x the median event count (passages of the South Atlantic Anomaly) or when any inter-event gap in reference or stream exceeds max_gap_seconds (data gaps). Transients inside kept windows are not removed. Hourly files overlap by about two minutes; repeated (TIME, PHA) events are dropped.
note_bracket: The null value of REAL-1 is the mean of the events within bracket_seconds before and after the stream, which tracks the current location and cancels a linear drift. On the development day the location drifted over minutes: the stream mean differed from the 300 s reference mean with standard deviation 0.031 against 0.010 expected from noise, so 'same location as the reference' is false on these data (moment 46-52, first order 66-67 crossings out of 226). Crossings at the reference mean are reported, not gated. Bracket 10 s gave stream-minus-bracket SD 0.0124 (proxy noise visible); 30 s gave 0.0109 against 0.0108 expected from noise alone, so 30 s was chosen.
note_margin: Stability margin declared from the reference alone: the region is enlarged to contain the central moments of each of 10 consecutive chunks of the reference window, and the first-order variance bound to the largest chunk variance.
development_result: Development day, 226 windows, bracket 30 s, margin variant: moment 2 crossings (CP upper 0.028), first order 9 (CP upper 0.068); median gain at shift 0.12 31.7%.

REAL-1.note: Gates the calibrated moment e-process, which is the claim. The first-order comparator is reported with its Clopper-Pearson bound; this choice was made on the development day, where the comparator's bound was 0.068 and both methods are affected by the noise of the bracket proxy.
